title: Home Automation
searchIntent: grok bot to run my smart home
intro: This is the category people did not predict and it is larger than several of the business ones: bots that watch a house. Charging schedules against electricity rates, network health, deliveries, thermostats, the robot vacuum. What makes it work is that a home produces a steady stream of small numbers nobody is watching, which is exactly the gap an always-on agent fills. The listings are highly personal — most were built for one house and shared afterwards — so expect to rewrite the specifics rather than install and go. The interesting design question is how much the bot is allowed to actuate. A bot that reports the tumble dryer finished is uncontroversial. A bot that changes the thermostat because electricity got cheap is making a decision on behalf of everyone in the building, which is worth agreeing with them first.
